# `r p$display_name`

Internal scouting document — decision support only. See `reports/player_report.Rmd` for the fully rendered MVP template used by `scripts/07_generate_reports.R`.

| Field | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Competition | `r toupper(p$league_id)` |
| Age | `r p$age` |
| Role | `r p$role_id` |
| Overall | `r round(p$score_overall, 1)` |
| Risk | `r round(p$score_risk, 1)` |
| Confidence | `r p$confidence` |
